an4.59:1.1: Bhojanaṃ bhikkhave dadamāno dāyako paṭiggāhakānaṃ imāni cattāri ṭhanāni deti. Katamāni cattāri? Āyuṃ deti, vaṇṇaṃ deti, sukhaṃ deti, balaṃ deti, sukhaṃ deti. Āyuṃ kho pana datvā āyussa bhāgī hoti dibbassa vā mānusassā vā, vaṇṇaṃ datvā . . . sukhaṃ datvā . . . balaṃ datvā balassa bhāgī hoti dibbassa vā mānusassa vā. Bhojanaṃ bhikkhave dadamāno dāyako paṭiggāhakānaṃ imāni cattāri ṭhānāni detīti.
an4.59:2.1: Yo saññatānaṃ paradattabhojinaṃ kālena sakkacca dadāti bhojanaṃ Cattāri ṭhānāni anupavecchati āyuñ ca vaṇṇañ ca sukhañ ca balañ ca
an4.59:3.1: So āyudāyī baladāyī sukha-vaṇṇa dado naro Dīghāyu yasavā hoti yattha yatth' upapajjatīti. Atha
